tob-2023_fext.name: Fext
tob-2023_fext.languages: the languages it knew in life
tob-2023_fext.senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 20 ft., passive Perception 14
tob-2023_fext.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fext makes two Eldritch Blade or Eldritch Fury attacks.

actions.name: Eldritch Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Fury
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Patron's Might
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The fext channels its patron's awe-inspiring presence, terrifying those nearby. Each creature within 10 feet of the fext must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 35 (10d6) psychic damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't frightened. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Eldritch Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The fext’s weapon attacks are magical. When the fext hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 force damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The fext has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Patron’s Blessing
special_abilities.desc: While the fext is conscious and wearing no armor and wielding no shield, it adds its Charisma modifier to its AC (included above).

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The fext doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

tob-2023_feyward-tree.name: Feyward Tree
tob-2023_feyward-tree.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
tob-2023_feyward-tree.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
tob-2023_feyward-tree.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The feyward tree makes two Razor-Leafed Branch attacks.

actions.name: Razor-Leafed Branch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) force damage.

actions.name: Flaying Leaves
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The feyward tree launches a barrage of razor-sharp cold iron leaves from its branches. Each creature within 20 feet of the tree must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 (8d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Aversion to Cold
special_abilities.desc: If the feyward tree takes cold damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The feyward tree doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Enchanted Leaves
special_abilities.desc: The feyward tree’s Razor-Leafed Branch attacks are magical. When the tree hits with its Razor-Leafed Branch, the branch deals an extra 9 (2d8) force damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The feyward tree is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Lightning Absorption
special_abilities.desc: Whenever the feyward tree is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hp equal to the lightning damage dealt.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The feyward tree has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Warden’s Reach
special_abilities.desc: A creature within 15 feet of a feyward tree that moves away from it provokes an opportunity attack even if the creature takes the Disengage action.

tob-2023_fidele-angel.name: Fidele Angel
tob-2023_fidele-angel.damage_resistances: fire, lightning, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fidele angel makes three Longsword or Radiant Bolt attacks. Alternatively, it makes one Beak attack and two Talons attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc:
Forma: Humanoid or True Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage, or 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc:
Forma: Bird Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc:
Forma: Bird Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Radiant Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) radiant damage.

actions.name: To My Lover's Side
actions.desc: If its mate is more than 1 mile away from it, the fidele angel can magically teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of its mate. The angel can use this action even if its mate is on another plane of existence.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The angel casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as its spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** detect evil and good, purify food and drink, spare the dying
- **3/Day Each:** bless, cure wounds, daylight

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The fidele angel transforms into a Medium or smaller Humanoid, a Large or smaller birdlike Beast, or back into its true form, which is a winged Celestial. Without wings, it loses its flying speed. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Ever Connected
special_abilities.desc: Fidele angels are magically connected. Damage taken by the fidele angel is split evenly between the fidele angel and its paired fidele angel. The angel that was the original target of the attack takes any damage that won’t divide evenly. All other effects, such as reducing ability scores or being the target of a bless spell, affect only the target.

special_abilities.name: Immortal Nature
special_abilities.desc: The fidele angel doesn’t require food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The angel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The angel’s weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Unshakeable Fidelity
special_abilities.desc: No spell, feature, trait, magic, or other effect can cause a fidele angel to act against or harm its mate or change its love or loyalty toward its mate.

tob-2023_firebird.name: Firebird
tob-2023_firebird.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The firebird makes one Beak attack and one Talon attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Blinding Ray
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The firebird fires a burning ray of light from its tail feathers in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 17 (5d6) fire damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Healing Feathers
actions.desc:
3/día.
The firebird touches another creature, brushing its wings against the creature. The target magically regains 10 (3d6) hp and is freed from any disease, poison, blindness, or deafness.

special_abilities.name: Enforce Good Deeds
special_abilities.desc: A creature that has received assistance, such as healing or a glowing feather, from the firebird must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the geas spell for 30 days. While under the geas, the affected creature must assist nonhostile creatures suffering from starvation or thirst by alleviating the starvation or thirst.

special_abilities.name: Fiery Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The firebird’s weapon attacks are magical. When the firebird hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 fire damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Glowing Feathers
special_abilities.desc: The firebird sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The firebird can alter the radius as a bonus action. If the firebird willingly gifts a feather to a creature, the feather sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet indefinitely.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The firebird has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Warming Presence
special_abilities.desc: The firebird and each creature within 5 feet of it are immune to the effects of cold environments, provided the cold is caused by naturally occurring weather and climate. When the firebird is inside a structure, it can choose for this trait to affect all creatures within the structure (no action required), regardless of how close they are to it.

tob-2023_firegeist.name: Firegeist
tob-2023_firegeist.condition_immunities: exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious

actions.name: Burning Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the target is a flammable object, it ignites. If the target is a creature, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or ignite. Until a creature takes an action to douse the fire, the target takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns.

actions.name: Burning Terror
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The firegeist assaults the mind of one creature it can see within 30 feet of it with the painful, humiliating memory of the firegeist's first death. The target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 14 (4d6) fire damage and is frightened for 1 minute. On a success, the target takes half the damage and isn't frightened. While frightened, the creature takes 3 (1d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Elemental Nature
special_abilities.desc: The firegeist doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Hide By Firelight
special_abilities.desc: The firegeist has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in fire or in areas lit by nonmagical fire.

special_abilities.name: Magical Light Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in an area of light created by a spell or other magical effect, the firegeist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

special_abilities.name: Variable Illumination
special_abilities.desc: The firegeist sheds dim light in a 5- to 20-foot radius. It can alter the radius as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Water Susceptibility
special_abilities.desc: For every 5 feet the firegeist moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller creature, the target is grappled (escape DC 15).

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Squatting Pin
actions.desc: One creature grappled by the flab giant must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 22 (5d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage and is restrained until the grapple ends. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't restrained, but it remains grappled until it escapes. While restrained, a creature takes 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the giant's turns. If the flab giant moves, the target is no longer restrained or grappled.

special_abilities.name: Massive Bulk
special_abilities.desc: A flab giant can’t take the Dash action. In addition, a creature attempting to grapple, push, or knock the giant prone has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks to do so.

tob-2023_flame-dragon-wyrmling.name: Flame Dragon Wyrmling
tob-2023_flame-dragon-wyrmling.senses: darkvision 60 ft., blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 15

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The dragon exhales fire in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Heated Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the flame dragon or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

tob-2023_flutterflesh.name: Flutterflesh
tob-2023_flutterflesh.damage_resistances: cold, lightning; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
tob-2023_flutterflesh.condition_immunities: charmed, paralyzed, exhaustion, poisoned, stunned, unconscious

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The flutterflesh makes three Bone Spur or Tormenting Gaze attacks. If two Tormenting Gaze attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. A paralyzed creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Bone Spur
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage, and the flutterflesh impales the target on one of its bone spurs, grappling the target (escape DC 16). The flutterflesh can have no more than two creatures impaled at a time.

actions.name: Tormenting Gaze
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) psychic damage.

actions.name: Creeping Death
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The flutterflesh emits a wave of necromantic energy, hastening the journey toward death. Each creature within 20 feet of the flutterflesh must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature below half its hp maximum has disadvantage on this saving throw.

special_abilities.name: Merciful Exchange
special_abilities.desc: If the flutterflesh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a melee attack, it can cut off one of the creature’s limbs. If it does so, the target is reduced to 1 hp instead.

special_abilities.name: Necrotic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The flutterflesh’s weapon attacks are magical. When the flutterflesh hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d8 necrotic damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: The flutterflesh regains 10 hp at the start of its turn. If the flutterflesh takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the flutterflesh’s next turn. The flutterflesh dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

special_abilities.name: Turn Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The flutterflesh has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The flutterflesh doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Psychic Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Hooked Spider Net
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage, and the target is restrained. While restrained, the target takes 5 (1d10) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. Any creature, including the restrained target, can take an action to remove the net by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength check. If the check succeeds by 5 or more, the creature breaks the net instead, and the folk of Leng can't use the broken net again until it finishes a long rest.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The folk of Leng casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** message, minor illusion
- **3/Day Each:** disguise self, suggestion

bonus_actions.name: Etherealness
bonus_actions.desc: The folk of Leng enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: The folk of Leng can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Leng Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If the folk of Leng dies on the Material Plane, it gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again, unless it is killed with radiant damage wielded by a good-aligned creature or its remains are sprinkled with holy water within 24 hours of its death. The folk’s new body appears in its family’s crypt in Leng.

special_abilities.name: Mortal Void Traveler
special_abilities.desc: The folk of Leng doesn’t require air or ambient pressure.

special_abilities.name: Phrenic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The folk of Leng’s weapon attacks are magical. When the folk hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 3d6 psychic damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: The folk of Leng regains 2 hp at the start of its turn. If the folk of Leng takes fire or radiant damage, this trait doesn’t function at the start of the folk’s next turn. The folk of Leng dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hp and doesn’t regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow fey makes two Dagger or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Traveler
bonus_actions.desc:
3/día.
While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Charging Archer
special_abilities.desc: If the forest hunter moves at least 10 feet straight toward a target after hitting the target with a Longbow attack, the forest hunter can make one Dagger attack against the target as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: If the forest hunter is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the hunter instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half the damage if it fails.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: The shadow fey has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put it to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Forest and Urban Hunter
special_abilities.desc: The forest hunter has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks to find and track Beasts and Humanoids.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The forest marauder makes two Boar Spear attacks. If both attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the marauder. The marauder can choose not to push a creature.

actions.name: Boar Spear
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Forest Ambusher
bonus_actions.desc: While in a forest, the forest marauder can take the Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Forest Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The giant has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in forested terrain.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the forest marauder has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fraughashar makes one Bite attack and one Dagger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Frost Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) cold damage.

special_abilities.name: Deft Snow Walk
special_abilities.desc: The fraughashar can move across icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check, and difficult terrain composed of ice and snow doesn’t cost it extra movement. In addition, the fraughashar has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone while in icy or snowy terrain.

tob-2023_frostveil.name: Frostveil
tob-2023_frostveil.damage_resistances: bludgeoning and piercing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The frostveil makes two Frozen Tendril attacks. If both attacks hit a Medium or smaller target, the target is grappled (escape DC 15), and the frostveil uses Snowy Engulf on it.

actions.name: Frozen Tendril
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Snowy Engulf
actions.desc: The frostveil engulfs a Medium or smaller creature grappled by it. The engulfed target is blinded and restrained, and it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the start of each of the frostveil's turns or take 4 (1d8) acid damage and 3 (1d6) cold damage. If the frostveil moves, the engulfed target moves with it. The frostveil can have only one creature engulfed at a time.

actions.name: Spirit Spores
actions.desc:
Recarga: 6.
The frostveil releases a puff of psychotropic spores around itself. Each creature within 10 feet of the frostveil must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) cold damage and is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't incapacitated. When an incapacitated creature moves, it moves in a random direction. An incapacitated creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Chilling Acidic Body
special_abilities.desc: A creature that touches the frostveil or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 (1d8) acid damage.

special_abilities.name: Damage Transfer
special_abilities.desc: While engulfing a creature, the frostveil takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the engulfed creature takes the other half.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the frostveil remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a formation of frost and ice.

special_abilities.name: Windborne
special_abilities.desc: In windy conditions, the frostveil’s flying speed increases to 30 feet. In a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour), its flying speed increases to 60 feet.

actions.name: Whip-Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target can't speak or cast spells with verbal components, and the crab can't use its Whip Claw on another target.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The garroter crab can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Strangling Divination
special_abilities.desc: A Humanoid reduced to 0 hp while grappled by the garroter crab experiences a brief vision of the future. This effect works like the divination spell, except the reply is only as a mental vision and it can be about any specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 30 days. Once a creature has received a vision in this way, it can’t do so again for 30 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gbahali makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack:+7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the gbahali can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Shifting Camouflage
special_abilities.desc: The gbahali’s hide adapts to its current surroundings. The gbahali has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in nonmagical, natural terrain.

tob-2023_gearforged-templar.name: Gearforged Templar
tob-2023_gearforged-templar.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
tob-2023_gearforged-templar.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gearforged templar makes four Greatsword or Javelin attacks. If two Greatsword attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the templar. The templar can choose not to push a creature.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The gearforged templar whirls its greatsword in a great arc. Each creature within 10 feet of the gearforged must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Defensive Zone
reactions.desc: When a creature enters the gearforged templar's reach, the templar makes one Greatsword attack against the creature.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: The gearforged templar adds 3 to its AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, the templar must be able to see the attacker and must be wielding a melee weapon.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The gearforged templar doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gerridae makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Bred to the Saddle
special_abilities.desc: The gerridae can’t be charmed or frightened while it has a rider.

special_abilities.name: Water Bound
special_abilities.desc: For every hour the gerridae spends on dry land, its hp maximum is reduced by 2 (1d4).

special_abilities.name: Water Walker
special_abilities.desc: The gerridae can move across the surface of water as if it were harmless, solid ground. This trait works like the water walk spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost knight makes three Battleaxe or Lance attacks. If the ghost knight is mounted, it can make two Battleaxe or Lance attacks, and its mount can make one melee weapon attack.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Lance
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

special_abilities.name: Locked Saddle
special_abilities.desc: The ghost knight can’t be knocked prone, dismounted, or moved against its will while mounted.

special_abilities.name: Mounted Warrior
special_abilities.desc: The ghost knight is rarely seen without its warhorse skeleton mount. The warhorse skeleton wears custom barding that raises its Armor Class to 15, and it has immunity to necrotic damage. While the ghost knight is mounted, its mount can’t be charmed or frightened.

special_abilities.name: Necrotic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The ghost knight’s weapon attacks are magical. When the knight hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 2d6 necrotic damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Spirited Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the ghost knight moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature while mounted and then hits with a Lance attack on the same turn, the ghost knight can use a bonus action to command its mount to make one melee weapon attack against that creature as a reaction.

special_abilities.name: Turning Defiance
special_abilities.desc: The ghost knight and any undead within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The ghost knight doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghostwalk spider makes one Bite attack and one Ghostly Snare attack, or it makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. If the ghostwalk spider is in its true form, the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hp, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hp, and is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Ghostly Snare
actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
(Ghostwalk Form Only) Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. Hit: The target is restrained by invisible webbing. While restrained in this way, the target is invisible. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 15 Strength check, bursting the webbing on a success. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; hp 15; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage).

bonus_actions.name: Ghostwalk
bonus_actions.desc: The ghostwalk spider magically takes on a ghostly form or returns to its true, tangible form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying becomes ghostly with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Ghostly Body (Ghostwalk Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The ghostwalk spider has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage and to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and it has immunity to the grappled, paralyzed, petrified, and restrained conditions.

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement (Ghostwalk Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The ghostwalk spider can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant ant makes one Bite attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the giant ant can't Bite a different target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The giant ant has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The giant ant queen makes two Bite attacks and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the giant ant queen can't Bite a different target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The giant ant queen has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Queen’s Scent
special_abilities.desc: Giant ants within 30 feet of the queen have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that attacked the queen within the last minute.

tob-2023_gilded-devil.name: Gilded Devil
tob-2023_gilded-devil.languages: Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, telepathy 120 ft.
tob-2023_gilded-devil.damage_resistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gilded devil makes two Golden Flail attacks or three Hurl Flame attacks.

actions.name: Golden Flail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hurl Flame
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) fire damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
The gilded devil magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

actions.name: Voracious Greed
actions.desc: The gilded devil magically consumes up to 1 cubic foot of nonmagical jewelry or coins made of precious material within 5 feet of it. It regains 5 hp for every 200 gp of the consumed objects' value. If the jewelry or coins are being worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the consumption.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The gilded devil casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):

- **At Will:** alter self, detect thoughts, suggestion
- **3/Day Each:** charm person, scrying

bonus_actions.name: Betrayal of Riches
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
One creature wearing jewelry (an object made of precious material and worth at least 100 gp) the gilded devil can see within 60 feet of it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target takes 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage and suffers an effect until it finishes a short rest. The effect is based on the location of the worn jewelry (devil's choice if worn in multiple locations): on upper limbs, its melee damage is halved; on lower limbs, its speed is halved; on head, it is blinded or deafened (devil's choice); on body, it has vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. On a success, the target takes half the damage and doesn't suffer an additional effect.

special_abilities.name: Devil’s Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the gilded devil’s darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Golden Flail
special_abilities.desc: The gilded devil’s Golden Flail attacks are magical. When the devil hits with the Golden Flail, the flail deals an extra 4d6 fire damage (included in the attack). In addition, the devil can transform the flail into gold jewelry or back into a weapon as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Liar’s Largesse
special_abilities.desc: If a creature accepts a gift of jewelry from the gilded devil, the creature becomes cursed until cured by a remove curse spell or similar magic. While cursed, the creature has disadvantage on saving throws against the devil’s spells and abilities.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The gilded devil has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 5 (2d4) poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and the glass gator can't use Constrict on another target.

reactions.name: Silt Cloud
reactions.desc: When it takes damage while underwater and within 5 feet of the bottom of a body of water, the glass gator stirs up a 10-foot-radius sphere of silt centered on it. The silt spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong current disperses it. The glass gator can then swim up to half its speed. The cloud of silt doesn't move with the glass gator.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The glass gator can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Constricting Lunge
special_abilities.desc: If the glass gator jumps at least 10 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the gator can make one Constrict attack against it as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The glass gator’s long jump is up to 15 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

special_abilities.name: Transparent
special_abilities.desc: The glass gator has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide while underwater or in dim light.

tob-2023_gnarljak.name: Gnarljak
tob-2023_gnarljak.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
tob-2023_gnarljak.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gnarljak makes one Gnawing Bite attack and two Chain Tail attacks, or it makes three Chain Tail attacks.

actions.name: Gnawing Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the gnarljak attaches to the target. While attached, the gnarljak can't make Gnawing Bite attacks, and at the start of each of the gnarljak's turns, the target takes 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Chain Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Secure Tail
bonus_actions.desc: When within 10 feet of the ground, structure, wall, or other solid surface, the gnarljak can secure its tail spike on a point in the surface within 10 feet of it. While secured, the gnarljak can't be knocked prone, it can't move more than 10 feet from that point, and its Chain Tail attack's reach is reduced to 5 feet. If the gnarljak is attached to a creature while its tail is secured, the creature is restrained until the gnarljak is no longer attached to it.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The gnarljak doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While the gnarljak remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal bear trap.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gnoll makes one Bite attack and two Battleaxe attacks.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Lightning Lope
bonus_actions.desc: The gnoll takes the Dash or Disengage action.

special_abilities.name: Harrying Attacks
special_abilities.desc: If the gnoll attacks more than one creature in the same turn, the first target has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: The gnoll has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of the gnoll’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn’t incapacitated.

tob-2023_goat-man.name: Goat-Man
tob-2023_goat-man.languages: understands Common, Giant, and Trollkin but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The goat-man makes one Bite attack and two Slam attacks. If both Slam attacks hit the same target, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Charge
special_abilities.desc: If the goat-man moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Slam attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

tob-2023_gray-thirster.name: Gray Thirster
tob-2023_gray-thirster.languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gray thirster makes two Claw attacks, or it makes one Claw attack and one Withering Turban attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Withering Turban
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or its hp maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target has disadvantage on this saving throw if it failed the saving throw against the thirster's Thirst Aura. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest with no levels of exhaustion. The target dies if this effect reduces its hp maximum to 0.

actions.name: Drought
actions.desc:
1/día.
The gray thirster draws the moisture from containers and creatures around it. Nonmagical water and other liquids within 20 feet of the thirster that aren't being worn or carried turn to dust. Each creature within 20 feet of the thirster that isn't a Construct or Undead must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage and up to 5 gallons of nonmagical liquid it is wearing or carrying turn to dust. On a success, a creature takes half the damage, and nonmagical liquids it is wearing or carrying don't turn to dust. Plants, Oozes, creatures with the Amphibious or Water Breathing trait, and creatures made mostly of water, such as water elementals or steam mephits, have disadvantage on the saving throw.

special_abilities.name: Thirst Aura
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 30 feet of the gray thirster must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the gray thirster’s Thirst Aura for the next 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Thirsting Dead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The gray thirster doesn’t require air, food, or sleep.

tob-2023_greater-death-butterfly-swarm.name: Greater Death Butterfly Swarm
tob-2023_greater-death-butterfly-swarm.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The swarm makes two Bites attacks.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage if the swarm has half of its hp or fewer. The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 10 (3d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, it takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

special_abilities.name: Potent Poison
special_abilities.desc: Undead with resistance or immunity to poison damage or the poisoned condition can be affected by the swarm’s poison.

special_abilities.name: Swarm
special_abilities.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temporary hp.

special_abilities.name: Weight of Wings
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn in the swarm’s space has its speed halved and must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become blinded. Both effects end when the creature ends its turn outside the swarm’s space. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the blinding effect of Weight of Wings for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Greyfur's Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The greyfur casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- **3/Day Each:** color spray, sleep

special_abilities.name: Glide
special_abilities.desc: The lemurfolk has membranes between its fore and hind limbs that expand when falling to slow its rate of descent to 60 feet per round, landing on its feet and taking no falling damage. It can move up to 5 feet horizontally for every 1 foot it falls. The lemurfolk can’t gain height with its gliding membranes alone. If subjected to a strong wind or lift of any kind, it can use the updraft to glide farther.

tob-2023_grim-jester.name: Grim Jester
tob-2023_grim-jester.languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Gnomish, telepathy 120 ft.
tob-2023_grim-jester.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Necrotic Claw
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Killing Joke
actions.desc: The grim jester tells an ancient, nihilistic joke to one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or fall prone in a fit of laughter, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for 1 minute. A creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is reduced to 0 hp instead. The incapacitated target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save or ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The grim jester casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** disguise self, grease
- **3/Day Each:** magic mouth (as an action), mirror image
- **1/Day Each:** mislead, seeming

bonus_actions.name: Joker's Shuffle
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 6.
The grim jester exchanges locations with a Medium or smaller creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The jester and target each teleport to the other's space, and each becomes covered in a magical illusion to look and sound like the other. A creature must take an action to visually inspect an illusion and succeed on a DC 19 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the jester and target are disguised. The illusions last for 1 minute, until the jester dies, or until the jester dismisses them as a bonus action.

special_abilities.name: Last Laugh
special_abilities.desc: Unless it is destroyed in a manner amusing to the god of death that created it, the grim jester gains a new body in 1d20 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears in a place of the god’s choosing.

special_abilities.name: Mock the Dying
special_abilities.desc: Death saving throws made within 60 feet of the grim jester have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Turn Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The grim jester has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The grim jester doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shadow fey guardian makes two Pike or Javelin attacks.

actions.name: Pike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Traveler
bonus_actions.desc:
2/día.
While in shadows, dim light, or darkness, the shadow fey disappears into the darkness and reappears in an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet. A tendril of inky smoke appears at the origin and destination when it uses this bonus action.

reactions.name: Protective Interference
reactions.desc: When a friendly creature the shadow fey guardian can see within 5 feet of it is the target of an attack, the guardian can impose disadvantage on the attack roll. To do so, the guardian must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: The shadow fey guardian has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put it to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Shadow’s Vigil
special_abilities.desc: The guardian has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks, and magical darkness doesn’t impede the guardian’s darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the shadow fey has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The gug makes two four Grasping Claw attacks, or it makes two Grasping Claw attacks and two Stomp attacks. It can replace one Grasping Claw attack with a use of Fling or Swallow.

actions.name: Grasping Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The gug has four Grasping Claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Fling
actions.desc: One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by the gug is thrown up to 60 feet in a random direction and knocked prone. If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take the same damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc: The gug makes one Grasping Claw attack against a Large or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the gug, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

special_abilities.name: Towering Strength
special_abilities.desc: The gug is considered to be a Gargantuan giant for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

tob-2023_gypsosphinx.name: Gypsosphinx
tob-2023_gypsosphinx.damage_resistances: necrotic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sphinx makes one Beak attack and two Claw attacks. If both Claw attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or take 14 (4d6) slashing damage and be knocked prone.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Carrion Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The gypsosphinx exhales rotting breath in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 21 (6d6) poison damage and 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a creature has disadvantage on death saving throws. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** comprehend languages, detect magic, mage hand
- **3/Day Each:** blur, dispel magic, locate object
- **1/Day Each:** major image, greater invisibility

legendary_actions.name: Beak Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The sphinx makes one Beak attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
The sphinx uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
The sphinx magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

special_abilities.name: Death Sense
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx can pinpoint, by scent, the location of each creature below half its hp maximum within 60 feet of it, and it can sense the general direction of creatures that don’t have all of their hp within 1 mile of it. In addition, the sphinx can foretell the age and manner of a creature’s death by looking at it. This effect doesn’t take into account possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of powerful spells or the creature making a radical change in its life’s path.

special_abilities.name: Inscrutable
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the sphinx’s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The sphinx’s weapon attacks are magical.

tob-2023_haugbui.name: Haugbui
tob-2023_haugbui.languages: the languages it knew in life, telepathy 120 ft.
tob-2023_haugbui.damage_resistances: acid, cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, thunder
tob-2023_haugbui.damage_immunities: poison; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
tob-2023_haugbui.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The haugbui makes three Psychic Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Psychic Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) psychic damage.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.desc: The haugbui magically turns invisible until it attacks or casts a spell, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment the haugbui wears or carries is invisible with it.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The haugbui casts one of the following spells, requiring no components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

- **At Will:** dancing lights, mending, purify food and drink, spare the dying
- **3/Day Each:** gust of wind, telekinesis
- **1/Day Each:** dispel magic, remove curse

bonus_actions.name: Sepulchral Scrying
bonus_actions.desc:
Recarga: 6.
While within 1 mile of its burial mound, the haugbui creates an invisible sensor within 5 miles of the mound for 1 minute. When it uses this bonus action and as a bonus action on each of its turns for the duration, the haugbui can switch between using its own senses and projecting its senses through the sensor. While projecting its senses through the sensor, it can see, hear, telepathically communicate, and cast spells as if it was in the sensor's space, and it is blinded and deafened with regard to its own senses. The sensor can be dispelled (DC 14).

special_abilities.name: Incorporeal Movement
special_abilities.desc: The haugbui can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, the haugbui has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Turn Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The haugbui has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

special_abilities.name: Undead Nature
special_abilities.desc: The hangbui doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The herald makes three Herald's Staff or Blood Bolt attacks, or it makes two Herald's Staff attacks and one Grasping Slam attack.

actions.name: Herald's Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Grasping Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and takes 9 (2d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, and the herald can't use its Grasping Slam on another target.

actions.name: Blood Bolt
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (5d8 + 3) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature with blood, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Call Blood
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Each creature with blood within 10 feet of the herald must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The herald then gains temporary hp equal to the single highest amount of necrotic damage dealt. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more also suffers one level of exhaustion.

bonus_actions.name: Grant Blood Rage
bonus_actions.desc: The herald of blood infuses reckless rage in one creature it can see within 60 feet of it that isn't a Construct or Undead. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be enraged for a number of rounds equal to the target's Constitution modifier. While enraged, the target has advantage on all melee attack rolls, and attack rolls against it have advantage. When the rage ends, the target takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage and suffers one level of exhaustion. A creature with any levels of exhaustion automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

special_abilities.name: Blood Armor
special_abilities.desc: Each time a creature with blood hits the herald with a melee attack while within 10 feet of the herald, the creature takes 4 (1d8) necrotic damage, and the herald’s AC increases by 1 until the end of its next turn. The herald’s AC can’t be increased to more than 20 from this trait.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The herald of darkness makes two Embrace Darkness or Shadow Sword attacks.

actions.name: Embrace Darkness
actions.desc:
Forma: Shadow Form Only.
Melee Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the herald's space. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Shadow Sword
actions.desc:
Forma: Fiend Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Majesty of the Abyss
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The herald of darkness emits a sinister burst of infernal power. Each creature within 15 feet of the herald and that can see it must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 27 (6d8) necrotic damage and is blinded for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't blinded. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also paralyzed until the end of its next turn. A blinded creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The herald magically transforms into a Large shadow or back into its true form, which is a Fiend. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Made of Shadows (Shadow Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The herald of darkness has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. In addition, it can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

special_abilities.name: Shadow’s Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the herald’s darkvision.

tob-2023_hoard-golem.name: Hoard Golem
tob-2023_hoard-golem.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
tob-2023_hoard-golem.damage_immunities: poison, psychic; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with adamantine weapons
tob-2023_hoard-golem.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hoard golem makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) force damage.

actions.name: Thieving Whirlwind
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The hoard golem partially disperses into a whirlwind of coins, gemstones, and other valuables then recoalesces. Each creature within 20 feet of the golem must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 44 (8d10) bludgeoning damage and loses one object it is wearing or carrying. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and doesn't lose an object. Each object the golem steals must weigh no more than 20 pounds and not be wrapped around or firmly attached to a creature. For example, the golem could steal a belt pouch full of coins or a creature's jewel-encrusted dagger, but it can't steal a creature's shirt or armor. The hoard golem steals objects of high value over those of minimal value. The stolen object becomes part of the golem's body and can't be retrieved until the golem dies.

special_abilities.name: Construct Nature
special_abilities.desc: The golem doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

special_abilities.name: Enchanted Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The golem’s weapon attacks are magical. When the golem hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 4d8 force damage (included in the attack).

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The golem has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Strike with Awe
special_abilities.desc: A creature that enters a space within 120 feet of the hoard golem or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks while it remains within 120 feet of the golem.

tob-2023_horakh.name: Horakh
tob-2023_horakh.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft., passive Perception 20

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The horakh makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the horakh scores a critical hit, it removes one of the target's eyes, provided the target has eyes, and places the eye in a fluid sac on its thorax. While missing half or less of its total number of eyes, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. While missing more than half its total number of eyes, the target is blinded until its sight is restored.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.desc: While in dim light or darkness, the horakh takes the Hide action.

special_abilities.name: Implant Egg
special_abilities.desc: If the horakh reduces a creature to 0 hp with a Bite attack or as a bonus action while within 5 feet of a creature with 0 hp, the horakh can implant an egg in the creature. The implanted egg rests in the creature’s eye socket for 14 days while it incubates. A host creature can carry only one horakh egg to term at a time. While the egg is implanted, the host can’t use its eye and has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Exactly 24 hours before the egg hatches, the host becomes blinded. When the egg hatches, the young horakh erupts from the host’s head, killing the host in the process.

special_abilities.name: Standing Leap
special_abilities.desc: The horakh’s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

tob-2023_hound-of-the-night.name: Hound of the Night
tob-2023_hound-of-the-night.languages: understands Elvish and Umbral but can't speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hound of the night makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) cold damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Frost Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The hound exhales frost in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.desc:
Recarga: 4.
The hound magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the hound can make one Bite attack.

special_abilities.name: Fey Scent
special_abilities.desc: The hound of the night has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell. If it is tracking a Fey, Giant, or Humanoid whose scent it knows, the hound can continue tracking that creature if the creature moves into the Border Ethereal or teleports, provided the creature isn’t in the Border Ethereal for more than 1 minute or that the creature doesn’t teleport more than 100 feet at a time.

tob-2023_hraesvelgr.name: Hraesvelgr
tob-2023_hraesvelgr.languages: Auran, Common, Giant (can't speak in roc form)
tob-2023_hraesvelgr.damage_immunities: cold; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack and two Talon attacks, or he makes three Fist attacks. Alternatively, he can make three Gale Blast attacks. If two Fist attacks hit one creature, the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc:
Forma: Roc Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d8 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fist
actions.desc:
Forma: Giant Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc:
Forma: Roc Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 17). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Hraesvelgr has two talons, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Gale Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.desc:
Forma: Roc Form Only.
Hraesvelgr makes one Beak attack against a Large or smaller creature he is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Hraesvelgr, and it takes 17 (5d6) acid damage at the start of each of Hraesvelgr's turns. Hraesvelgr can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

actions.name: Sudden Gust
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
Hraesvelgr unleashes a powerful gust of wind in a 60-foot line that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a DC 19 Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 63 (18d6) bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 15 feet away from Hraesvelgr. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: Hraesvelgr transforms into a roc or back into his true form, which is a Giant. His statistics, other than his speed, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

bonus_actions.name: Attack
bonus_actions.desc: Hraesvelgr makes a Fist or Talons attack.

bonus_actions.name: Move
bonus_actions.desc: Hraesvelgr moves up to his speed, or flies up to half his flying speed if in roc form, without provoking opportunity attacks.

bonus_actions.name: Ear-Splitting Screech
bonus_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Forma: Roc Form Only.
Hraesvelgr lets out an ear-splitting screech. Each creature within 30 feet of Hraesvelgr must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Hraesvelgr makes a Fist or Talons attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Hraesvelgr moves up to his speed, or flies up to half his flying speed if in roc form, without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Ear-Splitting Screech
legendary_actions.desc:
Coste: 2 acciones legendarias.
Forma: Roc Form Only.
Hraesvelgr lets out an ear-splitting screech. Each creature within 30 feet of Hraesvelgr must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) thunder damage and be deafened until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Influence Weather
special_abilities.desc: Nearby weather responds to Hraesvelgr’s desires. At the start of each minute, Hraesvelgr can choose to change the precipitation and wind within 3 miles of him by one stage, up or down (no action required). This effect works like the changing weather conditions aspect of the control weather spell, except Hraesvelgr can’t change the temperature and the conditions change immediately.

special_abilities.name: Keen Sight (Roc Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: Hraesvelgr has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Hraesvelgr fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

tob-2023_hulking-whelp.name: Hulking Whelp
tob-2023_hulking-whelp.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hulking whelp makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.desc: The hulking whelp transforms into a Huge, hulking canine or back into its true whelp form, which is Fey. Its statistics, other than its size and creature type, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

reactions.name: Defensive Transformation
reactions.desc:
Forma: Whelp Form Only.
When the hulking whelp is hit with an attack or when a creature it can see or hear within 30 feet of it threatens to harm it, it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or transform into its hulking canine form (see the Change Shape bonus action).

special_abilities.name: Frightened Anger (Hulking Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: The hulking whelp has disadvantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects that reduce strong emotions, such as the calm emotions spell.

special_abilities.name: Pacify (Hulking Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: A friendly creature that has interacted peacefully with the hulking whelp in its whelp form can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The hulking whelp must be able to hear the creature, who must take an action to make a DC 15 Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the hulking whelp transforms back into its whelp form on its next turn and stops attacking. If the hulking whelp takes damage before then, it remains in its hulking form and continues attacking.

special_abilities.name: Unleashed Emotion (Hulking Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: On each of the hulking whelp’s turns, it attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the hulking whelp attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack for two turns in a row, the hulking whelp uses Change Shape to return to its whelp form and stops attacking.

tob-2023_hundun.name: Hundun
tob-2023_hundun.languages: understands Celestial and Primordial, but can't speak intelligibly
tob-2023_hundun.damage_resistances: lightning, radiant, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
tob-2023_hundun.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, prone, stunned, unconscious

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hundun can use its Motivating Babble. It then makes four Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Motivating Babble
actions.desc: The hundun babbles incoherently at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or suffer one of the following effects until the end of its next turn. Roll a d4 to determine which effect happens.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The hundun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** create or destroy water, dancing lights, minor illusion, prestidigitation
- **3/Day Each:** black tentacles, fabricate (as an action), irresistible dance
- **1/Day Each:** creation (as an action), plant growth

special_abilities.name: Inscrutable
special_abilities.desc: The hundun is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain the hundun’s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The hundun has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Radiant Fists
special_abilities.desc: The hundun’s Slam attacks are magical. When the hundun hits with a Slam attack, the attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage (included in the attack).

tob-2023_iaaffrat.name: Ia'Affrat
tob-2023_iaaffrat.senses: darkvision 120 ft., blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 19
tob-2023_iaaffrat.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, stunned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ia'Affrat makes three Bite or Burning Claw attacks, or he makes four Flaming Insect Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc:
Forma: Shapeless Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 0 ft., one target in the swarm's space. Hit: 21 (6d6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, or 10 (3d6) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage if Ia'Affrat has half of its hp or fewer. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Burning Claw
actions.desc:
Forma: Humanoid Form Only.
